get_block_data: load Minecraft block data from the pickled block_data file in minecraft_specs
get_colour_data: load colour data for all Minecraft block types from the pickled color_data file
get_block_property_data: load block properties data for all Minecraft block types from the pickled block_property_data file
get_mob_property_data: load properties data for all Minecraft mobs from the pickled mob_property_data file
get_bid_to_colours: map Minecraft block IDs to their corresponding colours by joining block and colour data
get_schematics: load Minecraft schematics as numpy arrays with optional random sampling via a limit parameter
